### 10. The view: SPX-7

`SparseOps` has the shape `DESIGN_RECORDER.md`, section 7, gives every recording view: `final`,
two constructors, the five special members declared, one private `TaskRecorder&` as its only
member, every operation returning `TaskHandle`. It is not a base of `BLASOps` and shares no
member with it.

Signatures follow the dense family. Operands come in the order of the dense sibling (`axpy`
takes `alpha, x, y`; `gemv` takes `A, x, y, trans, alpha, beta`; `symv` takes
`A, x, y, uplo, alpha, beta`). A scalar that follows the dtype is a `BlasScalar`; `roti` takes
`c` and `s` as `double`, as `rot` does, so a complex value there is a compile error.
`Core::Uplo` has no default and the flags after it do, as in `symv` and `trsv`. An operand
whose values the call writes is taken by non-const reference: `gthr` and `gthrz` write
`x.values`, and `roti` updates it.

Two rules of `DESIGN_BLAS.md` carry over. `doti` is real-only and throws on a complex tensor,
naming `dotui` and `dotci`; those two on a real tensor forward to `doti`. And `sphemv` on a
real tensor forwards to `spsymv`. In both cases the recorded task is the real sibling's own.

```cpp
/**
 * @file sparse.hpp
 * @brief Declares SparseOps, the view that records the sparse BLAS operations.
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#pragma once

#include <SushiBLAS/engine.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/tensor.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/sparse_matrix.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/sparse_vector.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/core/blas_types.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task_handle.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task_recorder.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/scalar.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    /**
     * @brief Records the sparse-dense level 1 routines and the products and solves of a CSR
     *        matrix through a task recorder.
     * @see include/SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/README.md
     */
    class SparseOps final
    {
        public:
            /** @brief Builds a view that records through recorder, which must outlive the view. */
            explicit SparseOps(TaskRecorder& recorder) noexcept
                : recorder_(recorder)
            {

            }

            /** @brief Builds a view that records on engine's own graph. */
            explicit SparseOps(Engine& engine) noexcept
                : SparseOps(engine.get_recorder())
            {

            }

            /** @brief Copies the binding. */
            SparseOps(const SparseOps&) noexcept = default;

            /** @brief Moves the binding. */
            SparseOps(SparseOps&&) noexcept = default;

            /** @brief Refused: a view cannot be re-bound. */
            SparseOps& operator=(const SparseOps&) = delete;

            /** @brief Refused: a view cannot be re-bound. */
            SparseOps& operator=(SparseOps&&) = delete;

            /** @brief Destroys the view; the recorder is not owned. */
            ~SparseOps() = default;

            /**
             * @brief Records y[p] = alpha * x[p] + y[p] over the stored positions p of x.
             * @param y Dense, of the length x.size.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand or a scalar the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle axpyi(BlasScalar alpha, const SparseVector& x, Tensor& y);

            /**
             * @brief Records the dot product of a real sparse x and a dense y into result.
             * @param result Scalar tensor of the operands' dtype.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on a complex operand, or one the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle doti(const SparseVector& x, const Tensor& y, Tensor& result);

            /**
             * @brief Records the unconjugated dot product x^T * y of a sparse x and a dense y.
             * @param result Scalar tensor of the operands' dtype.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle dotui(const SparseVector& x, const Tensor& y, Tensor& result);

            /**
             * @brief Records the conjugated dot product x^H * y of a sparse x and a dense y.
             * @param result Scalar tensor of the operands' dtype.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle dotci(const SparseVector& x, const Tensor& y, Tensor& result);

            /**
             * @brief Records a gather: the values of x become the elements of y at x's positions.
             * @param x Its indices are read and its values written.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle gthr(const Tensor& y, SparseVector& x);

            /**
             * @brief Records a gather that also sets the gathered elements of y to zero.
             * @param x Its indices are read and its values written.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle gthrz(Tensor& y, SparseVector& x);

            /**
             * @brief Records a scatter: the elements of y at x's positions become the values of x.
             * @param y Dense, of the length x.size; its other elements are left as they are.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle sctr(const SparseVector& x, Tensor& y);

            /**
             * @brief Records the plane rotation x[p] = c * x[p] + s * y[p],
             *        y[p] = c * y[p] - s * x[p] over the stored positions p of x.
             * @param c Real for every dtype, as is s.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle roti(SparseVector& x, Tensor& y, double c, double s);

            /**
             * @brief Records y = alpha * op(A) * x + beta * y for a CSR matrix A.
             * @param y Must not overlap x or an array of A.
             * @param beta Exactly zero skips reading y.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand, flag or scalar the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle spmv(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& x, Tensor& y,
                            Core::Transpose trans = Core::Transpose::NO_TRANS,
                            BlasScalar alpha = 1.0, BlasScalar beta = 0.0);

            /**
             * @brief Records y = alpha * A * x + beta * y for a symmetric A stored as one triangle.
             * @param A Square; the entries outside the triangle uplo names are not used.
             * @param beta Exactly zero skips reading y.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand, flag or scalar the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle spsymv(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& x, Tensor& y, Core::Uplo uplo,
                              BlasScalar alpha = 1.0, BlasScalar beta = 0.0);

            /**
             * @brief Records y = alpha * A * x + beta * y for a Hermitian A stored as one triangle.
             * @param A Square; the other triangle and the diagonal's imaginary part are not used.
             * @param beta Exactly zero skips reading y.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand, flag or scalar the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle sphemv(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& x, Tensor& y, Core::Uplo uplo,
                              BlasScalar alpha = 1.0, BlasScalar beta = 0.0);

            /**
             * @brief Records C = alpha * op(A) * B + beta * C for a CSR matrix A and dense B, C.
             * @param C Rank 2; must not overlap B or an array of A.
             * @param beta Exactly zero skips reading C.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand, flag or scalar the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle spmm(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& B, Tensor& C,
                            Core::Transpose trans = Core::Transpose::NO_TRANS,
                            BlasScalar alpha = 1.0, BlasScalar beta = 0.0);

            /**
             * @brief Records the solution of op(A) * x = b for a triangular CSR A, overwriting b.
             * @param A Square; the entries outside the triangle uplo names are not used.
             * @param b Contiguous.
             * @throws std::invalid_argument on an operand or a flag the call does not accept.
             */
            TaskHandle sptrsv(const SparseMatrix& A, Tensor& b, Core::Uplo uplo,
                              Core::Transpose trans = Core::Transpose::NO_TRANS,
                              Core::Diag diag = Core::Diag::NON_UNIT);

        private:
            /// @brief The recorder every operation of this view records through.
            TaskRecorder& recorder_;
    };
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

### 11. Operation sources: SPX-8

#### 11.1 One form

Every source has the five steps of `DESIGN_BLAS.md`, section 8.1, with one addition: the index
type is a second dimension of the dispatch, and it is chosen before the task is recorded.

1. `K_OP`, the name `"sparse.<routine>"`, used in every message and as the task's name. The
   files of `doti` and `spsymv` take it as a parameter, because several methods share each.
2. Checks: flags; dtype agreement and routine domain; scalars; the sparse operand through its
   `describe_` function; the dense operands in signature order; extents between operands; the
   result tensor. They are in the public method, or in one `record_x<Conj>` function when
   several methods share a file.
3. The checks end by choosing the index type:
   `if (indices.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32) return record_x<int32_t>(...); return record_x<int64_t>(...);`
4. The function chosen, a template over `Index` in the anonymous namespace, declares the
   operands on an `OperandSet`, leases scratch if the routine has any, builds the
   `BlasMetadata`, and calls `Internal::execute_typed_task`.
5. The task body is one generic lambda. Its dtype arm builds the `CsrPattern<Index>` or the
   `IndexList<Index>`, casts the pointers, narrows every scalar with `as<T>()`, and calls
   `dispatcher.run` with two plain lambdas, one per kernel.

The function of step 4 is the shape `record_symv<Conj>` has in `DESIGN_BLAS.md`, section 8.2:
a function template that holds one generic lambda with plain lambdas inside. No generic lambda
is passed through another, and the kernels are submitted from named function templates. The
index type could not be a second `auto` parameter or a second arm inside the body without
nesting generic lambdas, which is the shape that loses host kernel symbols on intel-llvm.

The body captures raw pointers and integers. It captures no `Tensor`, no `SparseMatrix` and no
`SparseVector`; `TaskRecorder` keeps the storage alive from the `OperandSet`. A leased
`ScratchBuffer` is captured by value, through `[=]`, so the lease lives as long as the task.

Operand declarations. A routine that writes some elements of `y` and leaves the rest
(`axpyi`, `gthrz`, `sctr`, `roti`) declares `updates(y)`: the elements it does not write are
values an earlier task produced, and the task depends on them staying. The products declare
their output written when `beta` is zero and updated otherwise, as `gemv` and `gemm` do.

Metadata slots, in the one convention of `Internal::BlasMetadata`:

| Routine | Slots |
| --- | --- |
| `axpyi` | alpha 0-1 |
| `roti` | c 0-1, s 2-3 |
| `spmv`, `spmm` | alpha 0-1, beta 2-3, trans 4 |
| `spsymv`, `sphemv` | alpha 0-1, beta 2-3, uplo 4 |
| `sptrsv` | uplo 0, trans 1, diag 2 |
| `doti`, `dotui`, `dotci`, `gthr`, `gthrz`, `sctr` | none |

Domains. `gthr`, `gthrz` and `sctr` record with `Dispatch::Domain::ALL`; the rest take the
default, `REAL_AND_COMPLEX`. An integer tensor given to `axpyi` is refused by
`execute_typed_task` through `Dispatch::require_domain`, which throws `std::invalid_argument`
once SM-6 has landed, as it has by the time these packages run.

Every method records a task, also for an operand without entries. A dense BLAS source does the
same, and the kernels do nothing over a zero count.

#### 11.2 The ten files

`src/engine/sparse/spmv.cpp`, the worked example:

```cpp
/**
 * @file spmv.cpp
 * @brief Defines SparseOps::spmv, which records the sparse matrix-vector product task.
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
#include <kernels/sparse.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/scratch.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_set.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/utils.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/task_metadata.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/argument_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/accumulator_size.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/sparse_matrix_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/accumulator.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/device_policy.hpp>
#include <SushiRuntime/graph/task_types.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /** @brief Names the operation in its messages and in its task. */
        constexpr const char* K_OP = "sparse.spmv";

        /**
         * @brief Records the SPMV task of a CSR matrix whose indices have type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of SparseOps::spmv.
         */
        template<typename Index>
        TaskHandle record_spmv(TaskRecorder& recorder, const SparseMatrix& A,
                               const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand& a, const Tensor& x,
                               int64_t incx, Tensor& y, int64_t incy, Core::Transpose trans,
                               BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(A.row_offsets).reads(A.column_indices).reads(A.values).reads(x);
            if (beta.is_zero())
                operands.writes(y);
            else
                operands.updates(y);

            // Only a transposed product keeps partial sums: blocks of them, each as long as y.
            const std::size_t blocks = Core::is_transposed(trans)
                ? Kernels::SYCL::scatter_blocks(Device::profile_for(A.row_offsets.get_device()),
                                                a.cols, a.nnz)
                : std::size_t{0};
            const std::size_t partial_bytes = blocks * static_cast<std::size_t>(a.cols) *
                                              Internal::accumulator_bytes(A.values.dtype);
            const ScratchBuffer scratch =
                Internal::allocate_blas_scratch(recorder, A.row_offsets, partial_bytes, operands);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta = Internal::BlasMetadata(K_OP, "sparse.spmv"_op)
                                                    .scalar(alpha).scalar(beta).flag(trans);

            const int64_t rows = a.rows;
            const int64_t cols = a.cols;
            const int64_t nnz = a.nnz;
            const int64_t first_index = a.first_index;
            const void* read_offsets = A.row_offsets.data_or_null();
            const void* read_columns = A.column_indices.data_or_null();
            const void* read_values = A.values.data_or_null();
            const void* read_x = x.data_or_null();
            void* rw_y = y.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, A.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    const Kernels::CsrPattern<Index> pattern{
                        rows, cols, nnz, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_offsets),
                        static_cast<const Index*>(read_columns)};
                    auto pv = static_cast<const T*>(read_values);
                    auto px = static_cast<const T*>(read_x);
                    auto py = static_cast<T*>(rw_y);
                    const T alpha_t = alpha.as<T>();
                    const T beta_t = beta.as<T>();
                    auto partials = static_cast<Kernels::Accumulator<T>*>(scratch.data());

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::spmv<T, Index>(trans, pattern, pv, alpha_t, px,
                                                               incx, beta_t, py, incy);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::spmv<T, Index>(q2, trans, pattern, pv, alpha_t,
                                                                 px, incx, beta_t, py, incy,
                                                                 partials, blocks, deps2);
                        });
                });
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::spmv(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& x, Tensor& y,
                               Core::Transpose trans, BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
    {
        Dispatch::require_flag(trans, K_OP, "trans");
        Dispatch::require_dtype(x, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "x");
        Dispatch::require_dtype(y, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "y");
        Dispatch::require_real_scalar(alpha, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "alpha");
        Dispatch::require_real_scalar(beta, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "beta");

        const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand a = Dispatch::describe_sparse_matrix(A, K_OP, "A");
        const Dispatch::VectorOperand vx = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(x, K_OP, "x");
        const Dispatch::VectorOperand vy = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(y, K_OP, "y");

        const bool transposed = Core::is_transposed(trans);
        Dispatch::require_vector_length(vx, transposed ? a.rows : a.cols, "the columns of op(A)",
                                        K_OP, "x");
        Dispatch::require_vector_length(vy, transposed ? a.cols : a.rows, "the rows of op(A)",
                                        K_OP, "y");

        if (A.row_offsets.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
            return record_spmv<int32_t>(recorder_, A, a, x, vx.increment, y, vy.increment, trans,
                                        alpha, beta);
        return record_spmv<int64_t>(recorder_, A, a, x, vx.increment, y, vy.increment, trans, alpha,
                                    beta);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

The block count is computed from `A.row_offsets.get_device()`. The row offsets always have
storage, because they hold `rows + 1` elements; the values and the column indices of a matrix
without entries have none, and `Tensor::get_device()` throws without storage. The same tensor
anchors every scratch lease of the matrix routines.

`src/engine/sparse/spsymv.cpp`, two methods on one kernel pair:

```cpp
/**
 * @file spsymv.cpp
 * @brief Defines SparseOps::spsymv and sphemv, which record the one-triangle product tasks.
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
#include <kernels/sparse.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/scratch.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_set.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/utils.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/task_metadata.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/argument_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/accumulator_size.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/sparse_matrix_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/kernels/blas/conjugation.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/accumulator.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/device_policy.hpp>
#include <SushiRuntime/graph/task_types.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /**
         * @brief Records one one-triangle product task for a CSR matrix with indices of type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @tparam Conj Kernels::Unconjugated for SPSYMV, Kernels::Conjugated for SPHEMV.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of record_spsymv.
         */
        template<typename Index, typename Conj>
        TaskHandle record_spsymv_task(TaskRecorder& recorder, const char* op,
                                      SushiRuntime::Graph::OpID op_id, const SparseMatrix& A,
                                      const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand& a, const Tensor& x,
                                      int64_t incx, Tensor& y, int64_t incy, Core::Uplo uplo,
                                      BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(A.row_offsets).reads(A.column_indices).reads(A.values).reads(x);
            if (beta.is_zero())
                operands.writes(y);
            else
                operands.updates(y);

            // Every stored entry scatters to its mirror, so the product keeps partial sums.
            const std::size_t blocks = Kernels::SYCL::scatter_blocks(
                Device::profile_for(A.row_offsets.get_device()), a.rows, a.nnz);
            const std::size_t partial_bytes = blocks * static_cast<std::size_t>(a.rows) *
                                              Internal::accumulator_bytes(A.values.dtype);
            const ScratchBuffer scratch =
                Internal::allocate_blas_scratch(recorder, A.row_offsets, partial_bytes, operands);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta =
                Internal::BlasMetadata(op, op_id).scalar(alpha).scalar(beta).flag(uplo);

            const int64_t rows = a.rows;
            const int64_t cols = a.cols;
            const int64_t nnz = a.nnz;
            const int64_t first_index = a.first_index;
            const void* read_offsets = A.row_offsets.data_or_null();
            const void* read_columns = A.column_indices.data_or_null();
            const void* read_values = A.values.data_or_null();
            const void* read_x = x.data_or_null();
            void* rw_y = y.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, A.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    using Policy = Kernels::ConjugationFor<T, Conj>;
                    const Kernels::CsrPattern<Index> pattern{
                        rows, cols, nnz, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_offsets),
                        static_cast<const Index*>(read_columns)};
                    auto pv = static_cast<const T*>(read_values);
                    auto px = static_cast<const T*>(read_x);
                    auto py = static_cast<T*>(rw_y);
                    const T alpha_t = alpha.as<T>();
                    const T beta_t = beta.as<T>();
                    auto partials = static_cast<Kernels::Accumulator<T>*>(scratch.data());

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::spsymv<T, Index, Policy>(uplo, pattern, pv, alpha_t,
                                                                         px, incx, beta_t, py,
                                                                         incy);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::spsymv<T, Index, Policy>(q2, uplo, pattern, pv,
                                                                           alpha_t, px, incx,
                                                                           beta_t, py, incy,
                                                                           partials, blocks, deps2);
                        });
                });
        }

        /**
         * @brief Checks the operands of a one-triangle product and records its task.
         * @tparam Conj Kernels::Unconjugated for SPSYMV, Kernels::Conjugated for SPHEMV.
         */
        template<typename Conj>
        TaskHandle record_spsymv(TaskRecorder& recorder, const char* op,
                                 SushiRuntime::Graph::OpID op_id, const SparseMatrix& A,
                                 const Tensor& x, Tensor& y, Core::Uplo uplo, BlasScalar alpha,
                                 BlasScalar beta)
        {
            Dispatch::require_flag(uplo, op, "uplo");
            Dispatch::require_dtype(x, A.values.dtype, op, "x");
            Dispatch::require_dtype(y, A.values.dtype, op, "y");
            Dispatch::require_real_scalar(alpha, A.values.dtype, op, "alpha");
            Dispatch::require_real_scalar(beta, A.values.dtype, op, "beta");

            const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand a = Dispatch::describe_sparse_matrix(A, op, "A");
            Dispatch::require_operand(a.rows == a.cols, op, "A",
                                      "is {} x {}; a symmetric or Hermitian matrix is square",
                                      a.rows, a.cols);

            const Dispatch::VectorOperand vx = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(x, op, "x");
            const Dispatch::VectorOperand vy = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(y, op, "y");
            Dispatch::require_vector_length(vx, a.rows, "the order of A", op, "x");
            Dispatch::require_vector_length(vy, a.rows, "the order of A", op, "y");

            if (A.row_offsets.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
                return record_spsymv_task<int32_t, Conj>(recorder, op, op_id, A, a, x, vx.increment,
                                                         y, vy.increment, uplo, alpha, beta);
            return record_spsymv_task<int64_t, Conj>(recorder, op, op_id, A, a, x, vx.increment, y,
                                                     vy.increment, uplo, alpha, beta);
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::spsymv(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& x, Tensor& y,
                                 Core::Uplo uplo, BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
    {
        return record_spsymv<Kernels::Unconjugated>(recorder_, "sparse.spsymv", "sparse.spsymv"_op,
                                                    A, x, y, uplo, alpha, beta);
    }

    TaskHandle SparseOps::sphemv(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& x, Tensor& y,
                                 Core::Uplo uplo, BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
    {
        if (!Core::is_complex_dtype(A.values.dtype))
            return spsymv(A, x, y, uplo, alpha, beta);

        return record_spsymv<Kernels::Conjugated>(recorder_, "sparse.sphemv", "sparse.sphemv"_op, A,
                                                  x, y, uplo, alpha, beta);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

`src/engine/sparse/spmm.cpp`:

```cpp
/**
 * @file spmm.cpp
 * @brief Defines SparseOps::spmm, which records the sparse-times-dense matrix product task.
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
#include <kernels/sparse.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/core/common.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/scratch.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_set.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/utils.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/task_metadata.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/argument_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/matrix_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/sparse_matrix_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/accumulator.hpp>
#include <SushiRuntime/graph/task_types.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /** @brief Names the operation in its messages and in its task. */
        constexpr const char* K_OP = "sparse.spmm";

        /**
         * @brief Records the SPMM task of a CSR matrix whose indices have type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of SparseOps::spmm.
         */
        template<typename Index>
        TaskHandle record_spmm(TaskRecorder& recorder, const SparseMatrix& A,
                               const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand& a, const Tensor& B,
                               const Dispatch::MatrixOperand& b, Tensor& C,
                               const Dispatch::MatrixOperand& c, Core::Transpose trans,
                               BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(A.row_offsets).reads(A.column_indices).reads(A.values).reads(B);
            if (beta.is_zero())
                operands.writes(C);
            else
                operands.updates(C);

            // Only a transposed product carries C unrounded, and only where the dtype needs it.
            const std::size_t work_elements = Core::is_transposed(trans)
                ? static_cast<std::size_t>(c.matrix_elements)
                : std::size_t{0};
            const ScratchBuffer work = Internal::allocate_blas_scratch(
                recorder, A.row_offsets,
                Internal::running_solution_bytes(A.values.dtype) * work_elements, operands);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta = Internal::BlasMetadata(K_OP, "sparse.spmm"_op)
                                                    .scalar(alpha).scalar(beta).flag(trans);

            const Core::Layout layout = c.layout;
            const int64_t rows = a.rows;
            const int64_t cols = a.cols;
            const int64_t nnz = a.nnz;
            const int64_t first_index = a.first_index;
            const int64_t nrhs = c.cols;
            const int64_t ldb = b.leading_dimension;
            const int64_t ldc = c.leading_dimension;
            const void* read_offsets = A.row_offsets.data_or_null();
            const void* read_columns = A.column_indices.data_or_null();
            const void* read_values = A.values.data_or_null();
            const void* read_B = B.data_or_null();
            void* rw_C = C.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, A.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    const Kernels::CsrPattern<Index> pattern{
                        rows, cols, nnz, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_offsets),
                        static_cast<const Index*>(read_columns)};
                    auto pv = static_cast<const T*>(read_values);
                    auto pB = static_cast<const T*>(read_B);
                    auto pC = static_cast<T*>(rw_C);
                    const T alpha_t = alpha.as<T>();
                    const T beta_t = beta.as<T>();
                    auto wide = static_cast<Kernels::Accumulator<T>*>(work.data());

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::spmm<T, Index>(layout, trans, pattern, pv, nrhs,
                                                               alpha_t, pB, ldb, beta_t, pC, ldc);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::spmm<T, Index>(q2, layout, trans, pattern, pv,
                                                                 nrhs, alpha_t, pB, ldb, beta_t, pC,
                                                                 ldc, wide, deps2);
                        });
                });
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::spmm(const SparseMatrix& A, const Tensor& B, Tensor& C,
                               Core::Transpose trans, BlasScalar alpha, BlasScalar beta)
    {
        Dispatch::require_flag(trans, K_OP, "trans");
        Dispatch::require_dtype(B, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "B");
        Dispatch::require_dtype(C, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "C");
        Dispatch::require_real_scalar(alpha, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "alpha");
        Dispatch::require_real_scalar(beta, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "beta");

        const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand a = Dispatch::describe_sparse_matrix(A, K_OP, "A");
        Dispatch::require_rank(B, 2, K_OP, "B");
        Dispatch::require_rank(C, 2, K_OP, "C");
        const Dispatch::MatrixOperand b = Dispatch::describe_matrix_operand(B, K_OP, "B");
        const Dispatch::MatrixOperand c = Dispatch::describe_matrix_operand(C, K_OP, "C");
        Dispatch::require_same_layout(b, c, K_OP, "B", "C");

        const bool transposed = Core::is_transposed(trans);
        Dispatch::require_matrix_extent(b.rows, transposed ? a.rows : a.cols,
                                        "rows against the columns of op(A)", K_OP, "B");
        Dispatch::require_matrix_extent(c.rows, transposed ? a.cols : a.rows,
                                        "rows against the rows of op(A)", K_OP, "C");
        Dispatch::require_matrix_extent(c.cols, b.cols, "columns against the columns of B", K_OP,
                                        "C");

        if (A.row_offsets.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
            return record_spmm<int32_t>(recorder_, A, a, B, b, C, c, trans, alpha, beta);
        return record_spmm<int64_t>(recorder_, A, a, B, b, C, c, trans, alpha, beta);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

```cpp
/**
 * @file sptrsv.cpp
 * @brief Defines SparseOps::sptrsv, which records the sparse triangular solve task.
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
#include <kernels/sparse.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/scratch.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_set.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/utils.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/task_metadata.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/argument_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/sparse_matrix_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/accumulator.hpp>
#include <SushiRuntime/graph/task_types.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /** @brief Names the operation in its messages and in its task. */
        constexpr const char* K_OP = "sparse.sptrsv";

        /**
         * @brief Records the SPTRSV task of a CSR matrix whose indices have type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of SparseOps::sptrsv.
         */
        template<typename Index>
        TaskHandle record_sptrsv(TaskRecorder& recorder, const SparseMatrix& A,
                                 const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand& a, Tensor& b, Core::Uplo uplo,
                                 Core::Transpose trans, Core::Diag diag)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(A.row_offsets).reads(A.column_indices).reads(A.values).updates(b);

            const ScratchBuffer work = Internal::allocate_blas_scratch(
                recorder, A.row_offsets,
                Internal::running_solution_bytes(A.values.dtype) * static_cast<std::size_t>(a.rows),
                operands);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta = Internal::BlasMetadata(K_OP, "sparse.sptrsv"_op)
                                                    .flag(uplo).flag(trans).flag(diag);

            const int64_t rows = a.rows;
            const int64_t cols = a.cols;
            const int64_t nnz = a.nnz;
            const int64_t first_index = a.first_index;
            const void* read_offsets = A.row_offsets.data_or_null();
            const void* read_columns = A.column_indices.data_or_null();
            const void* read_values = A.values.data_or_null();
            void* rw_b = b.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, A.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    const Kernels::CsrPattern<Index> pattern{
                        rows, cols, nnz, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_offsets),
                        static_cast<const Index*>(read_columns)};
                    auto pv = static_cast<const T*>(read_values);
                    auto pb = static_cast<T*>(rw_b);
                    auto wide = static_cast<Kernels::Accumulator<T>*>(work.data());

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::sptrsv<T, Index>(uplo, trans, diag, pattern, pv,
                                                                 pb);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::sptrsv<T, Index>(q2, uplo, trans, diag, pattern,
                                                                   pv, pb, wide, deps2);
                        });
                });
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::sptrsv(const SparseMatrix& A, Tensor& b, Core::Uplo uplo,
                                 Core::Transpose trans, Core::Diag diag)
    {
        Dispatch::require_flag(uplo, K_OP, "uplo");
        Dispatch::require_flag(trans, K_OP, "trans");
        Dispatch::require_flag(diag, K_OP, "diag");
        Dispatch::require_dtype(b, A.values.dtype, K_OP, "b");

        const Dispatch::SparseMatrixOperand a = Dispatch::describe_sparse_matrix(A, K_OP, "A");
        Dispatch::require_operand(a.rows == a.cols, K_OP, "A",
                                  "is {} x {}; a triangular solve needs a square matrix", a.rows,
                                  a.cols);

        const Dispatch::VectorOperand vb = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(b, K_OP, "b");
        Dispatch::require_unit_increment(vb, K_OP, "b");
        Dispatch::require_vector_length(vb, a.rows, "the order of A", K_OP, "b");

        if (A.row_offsets.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
            return record_sptrsv<int32_t>(recorder_, A, a, b, uplo, trans, diag);
        return record_sptrsv<int64_t>(recorder_, A, a, b, uplo, trans, diag);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

```cpp
/**
 * @file doti.cpp
 * @brief Defines SparseOps::doti, dotui and dotci, which record the sparse dot product tasks.
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
#include <kernels/sparse.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/scratch.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_set.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/utils.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/task_metadata.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/argument_check.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/sparse_vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/kernels/blas/conjugation.hpp>
#include <SushiRuntime/graph/task_types.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /**
         * @brief Records one sparse dot product task for positions of type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @tparam Conj Kernels::Unconjugated for DOTI and DOTUI, Kernels::Conjugated for DOTCI.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of record_doti.
         */
        template<typename Index, typename Conj>
        TaskHandle record_doti_task(TaskRecorder& recorder, const char* op,
                                    SushiRuntime::Graph::OpID op_id, const SparseVector& x,
                                    const Dispatch::SparseVectorOperand& sx, const Tensor& y,
                                    int64_t incy, Tensor& result)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(x.indices).reads(x.values).reads(y).writes(result);

            const ScratchBuffer scratch = Internal::allocate_level1_scratch(
                recorder, x.values, static_cast<std::size_t>(sx.nnz),
                Kernels::SYCL::K_LEVEL1_PARTIAL_BYTES, operands);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta = Internal::BlasMetadata(op, op_id);

            const int64_t count = sx.nnz;
            const int64_t extent = sx.size;
            const int64_t first_index = sx.first_index;
            const void* read_indices = x.indices.data_or_null();
            const void* read_x = x.values.data_or_null();
            const void* read_y = y.data_or_null();
            void* write_result = result.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, x.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    using Policy = Kernels::ConjugationFor<T, Conj>;
                    const Kernels::IndexList<Index> positions{
                        count, extent, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_indices)};
                    auto px = static_cast<const T*>(read_x);
                    auto py = static_cast<const T*>(read_y);
                    auto pr = static_cast<T*>(write_result);

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::doti<T, Index, Policy>(px, positions, py, incy, pr);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::doti<T, Index, Policy>(q2, px, positions, py,
                                                                         incy, pr, scratch.data(),
                                                                         scratch.bytes(), deps2);
                        });
                });
        }

        /**
         * @brief Checks the operands of a sparse dot product and records its task.
         * @tparam Conj Kernels::Unconjugated for DOTI and DOTUI, Kernels::Conjugated for DOTCI.
         */
        template<typename Conj>
        TaskHandle record_doti(TaskRecorder& recorder, const char* op,
                               SushiRuntime::Graph::OpID op_id, const SparseVector& x,
                               const Tensor& y, Tensor& result)
        {
            Dispatch::require_dtype(y, x.values.dtype, op, "y");

            const Dispatch::SparseVectorOperand sx = Dispatch::describe_sparse_vector(x, op, "x");
            const Dispatch::VectorOperand vy = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(y, op, "y");
            Dispatch::require_vector_length(vy, sx.size, "the size of x", op, "y");
            Internal::require_scalar_result(result, x.values.dtype, op);

            if (x.indices.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
                return record_doti_task<int32_t, Conj>(recorder, op, op_id, x, sx, y, vy.increment,
                                                       result);
            return record_doti_task<int64_t, Conj>(recorder, op, op_id, x, sx, y, vy.increment,
                                                   result);
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::doti(const SparseVector& x, const Tensor& y, Tensor& result)
    {
        Dispatch::require_real_dtype(x.values, "sparse.doti", "x", "dotui or dotci");
        return record_doti<Kernels::Unconjugated>(recorder_, "sparse.doti", "sparse.doti"_op, x, y,
                                                  result);
    }

    TaskHandle SparseOps::dotui(const SparseVector& x, const Tensor& y, Tensor& result)
    {
        if (!Core::is_complex_dtype(x.values.dtype))
            return doti(x, y, result);

        return record_doti<Kernels::Unconjugated>(recorder_, "sparse.dotui", "sparse.dotui"_op, x,
                                                  y, result);
    }

    TaskHandle SparseOps::dotci(const SparseVector& x, const Tensor& y, Tensor& result)
    {
        if (!Core::is_complex_dtype(x.values.dtype))
            return doti(x, y, result);

        return record_doti<Kernels::Conjugated>(recorder_, "sparse.dotci", "sparse.dotci"_op, x, y,
                                                result);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

```cpp
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>

namespace SushiBLAS

    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /** @brief Names the operation in its messages and in its task. */
        constexpr const char* K_OP = "sparse.axpyi";

        /**
         * @brief Records the AXPYI task of a sparse vector whose positions have type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of SparseOps::axpyi.
         */
        template<typename Index>
        TaskHandle record_axpyi(TaskRecorder& recorder, BlasScalar alpha, const SparseVector& x,
                                const Dispatch::SparseVectorOperand& sx, Tensor& y, int64_t incy)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(x.indices).reads(x.values).updates(y);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta =
                Internal::BlasMetadata(K_OP, "sparse.axpyi"_op).scalar(alpha);

            const int64_t count = sx.nnz;
            const int64_t extent = sx.size;
            const int64_t first_index = sx.first_index;
            const void* read_indices = x.indices.data_or_null();
            const void* read_x = x.values.data_or_null();
            void* rw_y = y.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, x.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    const Kernels::IndexList<Index> positions{
                        count, extent, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_indices)};
                    auto px = static_cast<const T*>(read_x);
                    auto py = static_cast<T*>(rw_y);
                    const T alpha_t = alpha.as<T>();

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::axpyi<T, Index>(alpha_t, px, positions, py, incy);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::axpyi<T, Index>(q2, alpha_t, px, positions, py,
                                                                  incy, deps2);
                        });
                });
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::axpyi(BlasScalar alpha, const SparseVector& x, Tensor& y)
    {
        Dispatch::require_dtype(y, x.values.dtype, K_OP, "y");
        Dispatch::require_real_scalar(alpha, x.values.dtype, K_OP, "alpha");

        const Dispatch::SparseVectorOperand sx = Dispatch::describe_sparse_vector(x, K_OP, "x");
        const Dispatch::VectorOperand vy = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(y, K_OP, "y");
        Dispatch::require_vector_length(vy, sx.size, "the size of x", K_OP, "y");

        if (x.indices.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
            return record_axpyi<int32_t>(recorder_, alpha, x, sx, y, vy.increment);
        return record_axpyi<int64_t>(recorder_, alpha, x, sx, y, vy.increment);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```

```cpp
 * @author Mustafa Garip
 */

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse.hpp>

#include <vector>
#include <complex>
#include <cstdint>
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
#include <kernels/sparse.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/task.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/operand_set.hpp>

#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/scalar.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/task_metadata.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/blas/vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/engine/sparse/sparse_vector_operand.hpp>
#include <SushiBLAS/support/complex_arithmetic.hpp>
#include <SushiRuntime/graph/task_types.hpp>

namespace SushiBLAS
{
    using namespace SushiRuntime::Graph::Literals;

    namespace
    {
        /** @brief Names the operation in its messages and in its task. */
        constexpr const char* K_OP = "sparse.roti";

        /**
         * @brief Records the rotation task of a sparse vector whose positions have type Index.
         * @tparam Index int32_t or int64_t.
         * @pre The operands have passed the checks of SparseOps::roti.
         */
        template<typename Index>
        TaskHandle record_roti(TaskRecorder& recorder, SparseVector& x,
                               const Dispatch::SparseVectorOperand& sx, Tensor& y, int64_t incy,
                               BlasScalar c, BlasScalar s)
        {
            OperandSet operands;
            operands.reads(x.indices).updates(x.values).updates(y);

            const Internal::BlasMetadata meta =
                Internal::BlasMetadata(K_OP, "sparse.roti"_op).scalar(c).scalar(s);

            const int64_t count = sx.nnz;
            const int64_t extent = sx.size;
            const int64_t first_index = sx.first_index;
            const void* read_indices = x.indices.data_or_null();
            void* rw_x = x.values.data_or_null();
            void* rw_y = y.data_or_null();

            return Internal::execute_typed_task(recorder, meta.get(), operands, x.values.dtype,
                                                "Sparse operation",
                [=](auto scalar_type, const Internal::KernelPairDispatcher& dispatcher,
                    sycl::queue& q, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps) -> sycl::event
                {
                    using T = decltype(scalar_type);
                    using R = Kernels::RealType<T>;
                    const Kernels::IndexList<Index> positions{
                        count, extent, first_index, static_cast<const Index*>(read_indices)};
                    auto px = static_cast<T*>(rw_x);
                    auto py = static_cast<T*>(rw_y);
                    const R c_t = c.as<R>();
                    const R s_t = s.as<R>();

                    return dispatcher.run(q, deps,
                        [=]
                        {
                            Kernels::Reference::roti<T, Index>(px, positions, py, incy, c_t, s_t);
                        },
                        [=](sycl::queue& q2, const std::vector<sycl::event>& deps2) -> sycl::event
                        {
                            return Kernels::SYCL::roti<T, Index>(q2, px, positions, py, incy, c_t,
                                                                 s_t, deps2);
                        });
                });
        }
    } // namespace

    TaskHandle SparseOps::roti(SparseVector& x, Tensor& y, double c, double s)
    {
        Dispatch::require_dtype(y, x.values.dtype, K_OP, "y");

        const Dispatch::SparseVectorOperand sx = Dispatch::describe_sparse_vector(x, K_OP, "x");
        const Dispatch::VectorOperand vy = Dispatch::describe_vector_operand(y, K_OP, "y");
        Dispatch::require_vector_length(vy, sx.size, "the size of x", K_OP, "y");

        if (x.indices.dtype == Core::DataType::INT32)
            return record_roti<int32_t>(recorder_, x, sx, y, vy.increment, c, s);
        return record_roti<int64_t>(recorder_, x, sx, y, vy.increment, c, s);
    }
} // namespace SushiBLAS
```
